content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have one major weakness: they can be shut off at any moment, leaving you without a way to receive payments. In the case of Zimbabwe, the government has imposed strict regulations on foreign payment processors, effectively blocking them from operating in the country. This is where the Complete Builder Kit ($197) comes into play, providing you with a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to accept payments directly from your customers, without relying on any third-party platform. By using NOWPayments, you can receive Bitcoin payments and convert them to USD in real-time, giving you the flexibility to sell your ebooks and digital products without worrying about platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a few key components. First, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account, which will give you access to the API keys you need to integrate with your stack. Next, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages site, which will serve as the frontend of your digital store. Finally, you'll need to create a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script, which will handle the backend logic of your store, including payment processing and order fulfillment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your NOWPayments account and GitHub Pages site set up, it's time to integrate them with your Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script. You'll need to use the NOWPayments API to set up a webhook that will trigger whenever a payment is received, and then use the Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script to process the payment and fulfill the order. This will involve setting up a payment gateway, creating a delivery pipeline, and configuring the webhook to trigger on receipt of payment.

With NOWPayments, you can accept Bitcoin payments and convert them to USD in real-time, giving you the flexibility to sell your ebooks and digital products without worrying about platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live with your digital store. This will involve deploying your GitHub Pages site, setting up your Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script, and configuring your NOWPayments account to receive payments. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be ready to process your first transaction, and start selling your ebooks and digital products directly to your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, you'll need to start thinking about scaling your infrastructure to handle increased demand. This will involve setting up load balancing, caching, and other performance optimization techniques to ensure that your site can handle a large volume of traffic. You'll also need to set up monitoring and logging to ensure that you can quickly identify and resolve any issues that may arise.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most common question we get is, 'Can I really sell ebooks and digital products without using platforms like Stripe and PayPal?' The answer is yes, with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and NOWPayments, you can set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to accept payments directly from your customers, without relying on any third-party platform. By using NOWPayments, you can receive Bitcoin payments and convert them to USD in real-time, giving you the flexibility to sell your ebooks and digital products without worrying about platform restrictions.

By using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to accept payments directly from your customers, without relying on any third-party platform.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and set up your API keys; set up a GitHub Pages site to serve as the frontend of your digital store; create a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script to handle the backend logic of your store, including payment processing and order fulfillment; integrate your NOWPayments account with your Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script; deploy your GitHub Pages site and set up your Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script; configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between NOWPayments and Stripe or PayPal?

NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee, compared to Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction and PayPal's 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, making it a much more cost-effective option for selling ebooks and digital products.
Can I accept other cryptocurrencies besides Bitcoin?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin, giving you the flexibility to accept a wide range of payment options from your customers.
How do I set up a webhook with NOWPayments?

To set up a webhook with NOWPayments, you'll need to create a new webhook in your NOWPayments account and configure it to trigger on receipt of payment. You can then use the webhook to trigger your Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers script to process the payment and fulfill the order.
Can I use NOWPayments with other e-commerce platforms?

Yes, NOWPayments can be integrated with a wide range of e-commerce platforms, including Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento, giving you the flexibility to use NOWPayments with your existing e-commerce setup.
